items.t: Brake control unit corrosion reduces braking (recall)
items.job: Inspect brake control unit, replace if corroded, flush brake fluid
items.note: Free under the recall and the 15-year control unit warranty extension. Use only DOT 4 brake fluid afterward.

items.t: ABS module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install revised ABS module fuse
items.note: Free at a Hyundai or Genesis dealer.

items.t: Brake lights may not work (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch / repair stop lamp circuit
items.note: Free under recall. Out of recall, a brake light switch is a small job of about an hour.

items.t: Engine shuts off while driving at low speed
items.job: Diagnose stall; clean and tighten battery and power connections or replace fuse box
items.note: Simple connection repairs are cheap; a replacement engine-bay fuse box or sensor costs more.

items.t: Engine knocking or seized engine
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $6,000-$8,700 for this repair. Check for warranty or goodwill coverage first.

items.t: Harsh or delayed shifts (8-speed automatic)
items.job: Transmission software update and clutch pressure relearn
items.note: Covered under warranty when it applies. Slipping that needs internal repair costs far more.

items.t: Shudder or rough shifting (6-speed automatic)
items.job: Transmission computer update and fluid check
items.note: Fluid service adds parts cost if needed.

items.t: Battery keeps going dead
items.job: Parasitic drain test and repair of faulty circuit or radio
items.note: A wiring fix is cheap; one owner was quoted about $1,200 for a new radio.

items.t: Idle speed surges when cold
items.job: Replace throttle position sensor / throttle body and update engine computer
items.note: A sensor alone costs less than a full throttle body.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling from a dirty throttle body
items.job: Clean or replace throttle body and relearn idle
items.note: Cleaning alone is a low-cost first step.

items.t: Windshield wipers stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor cover and seal
items.note: Free under recall. A full wiper motor out of warranty is about $900.

items.t: Clear coat peeling and paint chipping
items.job: Refinish bumpers and rocker panels
items.note: Owners report $700 to about $1,600 depending on how many panels need paint.

items.t: Sudden loss of all electrical power or no start
items.job: Clean and tighten battery terminals and fuse block power lead
items.note: A failed engine computer costs much more.

items.t: Starter solenoid can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install starter relay kit in engine junction box
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Power seat motor can overheat (recall)
items.job: Front power seat recall repair
items.note: Free under recall once the remedy is available.

items.t: Parking brake warning light may not come on (recall)
items.job: Replace parking brake switch
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Instrument cluster shows wrong speed or warning lights (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Original tires can crack in the sidewall (recall)
items.job: Replace original tires
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Water in tail lights causes wrong gear display (recall)
items.job: Install water-blocking pads in rear lamps
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor connector can come loose (recall)
items.job: Secure occupant sensor connector
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Car can move if started in gear (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition lock switch
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Rear differential bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct rear differential mounting
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Driver airbag bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and retighten driver airbag bolts
items.note: Free under recall.

items.t: Cam timing (CVVT) codes and timing chain wear
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and cam phasers
items.note: One owner reports about $5,000 when the engine was damaged.

items.t: Engine revs hang between shifts
items.job: Engine computer reflash
items.note: Often done under warranty when the car was newer.

items.t: Clutch slave or master cylinder failure
items.job: Replace clutch slave cylinder and bleed system
items.note: Master cylinder replacement is a similar cost.
